fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Gelato API key (dashboard > Developer > API keys), sent as `X-API-KEY`. Product endpoints live on product.gelatoapis.com and are called by absolute URL.

me.note: Gelato has no account endpoint; the probe lists the catalogs ([{catalogUid, title}]) with the key, so `account` is empty on success.

list_products.note: POST /v3/catalogs/{catalogUid}/products:search; `category` is the catalogUid (posters, cards, apparel, ... from GET /v3/catalogs) and is required by this endpoint, `query` is not accepted (attributeFilters are not mapped). Products have no name: `title` is the productUid; attributes, weight and dimensions are in `raw`.

get_product.note: GET /v3/products/{productUid}: {productUid, attributes, weight, supportedCountries, notSupportedCountries, isStockable, isPrintable, validPageCounts}; `title` is the productUid. Prices per quantity come from GET /v3/products/{productUid}/prices (not mapped).

get_order.note: GET /v4/orders/{orderId}: {id, orderType, orderReferenceId, fulfillmentStatus, financialStatus, currency, createdAt, items[], shipment{shipmentMethodUid, packages[{trackingCode, trackingUrl}]}, receipts[{totalInclVat}]}; `status` is the fulfillmentStatus (created, passed, printed, shipped, draft, ...), `total` the first receipt's totalInclVat.

not_offered.create_order: POST /v4/orders requires `orderReferenceId` ('Reference to your internal order id.') and `customerReferenceId` ('Reference to your internal customer id.') plus `currency` and items[{itemReferenceId, productUid, files[{type, url}], quantity}]; the vocabulary carries none of these references, so the body cannot be built without inventing values.
not_offered.quote_shipping: POST /v4/orders:quote takes nested products[{itemReferenceId, productUid, files, quantity}] + recipient{country, ...}; the vocabulary's product_id/country/quantity cannot be shaped into that body by the runtime's flat body form.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; shipment.packages[{trackingCode, trackingUrl}] are part of GET /v4/orders/{orderId} (see get_order).
